main_text.p: [?]itatis in Frisia Orientali Occo BROEC-Occo Broec-meri eques, Kenonis fil.MERIVS, [?]studio augenda potentia sua, in clientelam se ALBERTI BAVARI Hollandiae, Selandiae, Hannoniae Comitis, qui iamdudum Frisijs imminebat, contulisset, Frisij omnes inter Flevum & Lavicam fl. OSTERGOI, VVES-Foedus Traf-lavicanorum cumGronin-ganis,TERGOI, SEVENVVOLDII, qui erant periculis ab Hollandis proximi, metuentes libertatis suae foedus cum civitate Groningana in hoc summo discrimine percusserunt. Nam non Broecmerius solum formidini erat novus Bavari clientis, praepotens opibus, qui scindere in partes gentem, proprijs viribus atterere posse videbatur, sed factiones quoq; in Fivelgonia ac Hunefgonia se subrigentes, in quib. nobilitatis pars eundem Bavarum ac Hollandos spectare ferebatur. His vero periculis nil validius opponi posse omnes existimabant, quam cum civitate hac nostra foedus. Eo foedere promisit civitas, fidam se sociam foederatis, omnibusq; Frisijs liberis futuram, societati huic fortunas & corpora, si posceret res, impensuram, libertatem suam & foederatorum contra vim perogrinorum principum quorumvis, & factiosae nobilitatis pro viribus defensuram, si qua clades sociis accideret in praelio, iis periculo perculsis & receptum quaerentibus portas se suas aperturam, factiosos in Hunefgonia & Fivelgonia huic foederi obnitentes, & concordiam distinentes, ne reip. malo fint, compressuram. page.notes: Right margin notes (three) are in the printed page's right margin; the first note reads "Occo Broec-meri eques, Kenonis fil." and the second "Foedus Traf-lavicanorum cum Gronin-ganis,". Several words in the main text are faint or blurred (notably the start line, "subrigentes", "Hunefgonia", "compressuram", and the last line before the foot); they are marked [?] or left uncertain. The word at the foot right is illegible, and the catchword is a guess. The black-letter-like or stained areas and show-through were not transcribed. Greek and italic run-in words were treated as printed. Heading "IN AGRVM VICINVM." is the running head.
